newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany must back nuclear energy - business leaders.
newsitem.headline: Germany must back nuclear energy - business leaders.

text.p: The German economy would suffer irreparable damage if firms were to pull out of the nuclear power business, the BDI Federation of German Industry warned on Wednesday.

Juergen Heraeus, head of BDI's energy committee, told a news conference Germany would lose touch with international developments if it retreated from nuclear energy, as it had already done with semiconductors and gene technology.
While Heraeus noted that Germany did not currently need any new nuclear power plants, he said existing plants would have to be replaced in the long term.
The BDI said the nuclear power sector had created 38,000 jobs in Germany. The 20 nuclear plants in the country had reduced usage of imported power to 10 percent in 1995 from 25 percent in 1973.
